interface.name: libjpeg-turbo
interface.summary: JPEG image codec and command-line tools
interface.description: libjpeg-turbo is a JPEG image codec that uses SIMD instructions to accelerate baseline JPEG compression and decompression. This package also provides its command-line tools: jpegtran for lossless transformations of JPEG files (rotation, flipping, cropping, optimization and conversion between baseline and progressive encoding), cjpeg and djpeg for compressing and decompressing JPEG files, and rdjpgcom and wrjpgcom for reading and writing JPEG comments.

entry-point.name: cjpeg
entry-point.summary: compress an image file to a JPEG file

entry-point.name: djpeg
entry-point.summary: decompress a JPEG file to an image file

entry-point.name: rdjpgcom
entry-point.summary: display text comments from a JPEG file

entry-point.name: wrjpgcom
entry-point.summary: insert text comments into a JPEG file
